rules.name: cash-refresh-06-ocf-ogb-cfs
rules.sql: WITH candidates AS ( SELECT d.trade_id, left(d.contract_number,3) AS client_code, d.contract_number, d.security_id, d.subportfolio, d.counterparty_parent, d.is_latest_version, d.transaction_date, d.netting_status, d.netting_date, d.original_lots, d.active_lots AS cloned_active_lots, d.premium AS deal_premium, s.derivative_type, s.product_code AS invenio_product_code, s.maturity_date, s.currency AS security_currency, pm.bbg_product_code, p.is_premium_paid, p.transaction_date AS premium_paid_date FROM opera_backup_04_10.cloned_deal_ticket_table d LEFT JOIN opera_backup_04_10.cloned_security_info_table s ON s.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND s.business_unit=d.business_unit AND s.security_id=d.security_id LEFT JOIN opera_backup_04_10.rms_premium_paid_table p ON p.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND p.business_unit=d.business_unit AND p.trade_id=d.trade_id LEFT JOIN opera_backup_04_10.product_master_table pm ON pm.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND pm.invenio_product_code=s.product_code WHERE d.tenant_id=:tenant AND d.business_unit='CFS' AND left(d.contract_number,3) IN ('OCF','OGB') AND upper(s.derivative_type)='FX_FORWARD_NDF' AND upper(pm.bbg_product_code)='USDBRL' ), scoped AS ( SELECT c.*, (c.is_latest_version=1 AND lower(c.subportfolio) LIKE 'rms%' AND lower(c.subportfolio) NOT LIKE '%oid' AND lower(c.counterparty_parent) NOT LIKE 'jpm%') AS s1_pass, (c.transaction_date < :valueDate) AS pre_value_date, (c.is_premium_paid=1 AND c.premium_paid_date=:cob) AS paid_on_cob, (c.maturity_date=:cob AND (c.is_premium_paid=0 OR c.is_premium_paid IS NULL) AND lower(c.netting_status) IN ('not_netted','partially_netted')) AS unpaid_maturity_event, (lower(c.netting_status) IN ('fully_netted','partially_netted') AND c.netting_date=:valueDate) AS netting_event FROM candidates c ), gates AS ( SELECT x.*, (x.s1_pass AND x.pre_value_date AND (x.paid_on_cob OR x.unpaid_maturity_event OR x.netting_event)) AS s2_cash_event_pass, fy.financial_year AS matching_financial_year, (fy.trade_id IS NOT NULL) AS s4_fy_premium_pass, lots.value_date AS latest_lots_date, lots.active_lots AS latest_active_lots, (lots.trade_id IS NOT NULL) AS s3_active_lots_pass FROM scoped x LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT y.financial_year FROM opera_backup_04_10.financial_year_table y WHERE y.tenant_id=:tenant AND y.start_date<=:cob AND y.end_date>=:cob ORDER BY y.start_date DESC LIMIT 1) fydate ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT pf.trade_id,pf.financial_year FROM opera_backup_04_10.premium_fy_table pf WHERE pf.tenant_id=:tenant AND pf.business_unit='CFS' AND pf.trade_id=x.trade_id AND pf.financial_year=fydate.financial_year LIMIT 1) fy ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT al.trade_id,al.value_date,al.active_lots FROM opera_backup_04_10.deal_active_lots_table al WHERE al.tenant_id=:tenant AND al.business_unit='CFS' AND al.trade_id=x.trade_id AND al.value_date<=:valueDate ORDER BY al.value_date DESC LIMIT 1) lots ON true ) SELECT 'backup' AS snapshot, trade_id,client_code,contract_number,security_id, derivative_type,invenio_product_code,bbg_product_code,security_currency, subportfolio,counterparty_parent,is_latest_version,s1_pass,transaction_date,pre_value_date, maturity_date,netting_status,netting_date,is_premium_paid,premium_paid_date, paid_on_cob,unpaid_maturity_event,netting_event,s2_cash_event_pass, matching_financial_year,s4_fy_premium_pass,latest_lots_date,latest_active_lots, s3_active_lots_pass, (s1_pass AND pre_value_date AND (paid_on_cob OR unpaid_maturity_event OR netting_event) AND s4_fy_premium_pass AND s3_active_lots_pass) AS core_report_eligible FROM gates ORDER BY client_code,trade_id

matching_financial_year,s4_fy_premium_pass,latest_lots_date,latest_active_lots, s3_active_lots_pass, (s1_pass AND pre_value_date AND (paid_on_cob OR unpaid_maturity_event OR netting_event) AND
